title: Policy-change underreaction drift with hike/cut asymmetry: an evidenced-availability event study on the daily 16:00-NY decision clock
mechanism: When a central bank CHANGES its policy rate, the exchange-rate response documented in the announcement literature has an instantaneous jump component (Andersen, Bollerslev, Diebold & Vega 2003 AER; Faust, Rogers, Wang & Wright 2007 JME) but the position-relevant claim under test is the residual DRIFT: benchmarked global allocators rebalance on monthly/quarterly cycles, hedging-cost adjustments lag, and trend systems require multi-day confirmation, so the currency whose rate path shifted continues to drift in the direction of the change for days after the change becomes READABLE (Taylor-rule fundamentals carry out-of-sample predictive content at short horizons - Molodtsova & Papell 2009; the honest counterweight is Rossi 2013: most FX fundamentals fail out-of-sample, so the claim is deliberately narrow and event-gated). The asymmetry arm encodes the documented transmission asymmetry between telegraphed, gradual tightening and faster-priced emergency easing (asymmetric policy effects: Cover 1992 as cross-asset analog; FX-specific hike/cut asymmetry citations are weaker and marked unverified below), by shortening the cut holding horizon. Quantitative law, frozen. Events are RATE_CHANGE rows of the pinned v2 announcement ledger (sha256 ae5e1f2e64b8aa7c08472755bd73857543aa89b72ea81b70ad5c5d81e7cd6bd4; 220 rows = 212 RATE_CHANGE + 8 BASELINE_LEVEL, areas AU/NZ/CA/CH/GB/US/EMU/JP; 108 rows carry EVIDENCED stamps, the remainder carry conservative LATER bounds - the P2 data authority classifies 108/151 rate changes evidenced incl. all 8 areas' baselines; every row carries operative_available_time_utc / first_readable_decision_utc, so every event is availability-gated either way). An event in area A has delta = new_value - old_value != 0 and availability instant a = operative_available_time_utc. Direction: for A != US, P(A) is the unique authorized pair containing A as the non-USD leg (EMU->EUR/USD, GB->GBP/USD, AU->AUD/USD, NZ->NZD/USD, JP->USD/JPY, CH->USD/CHF, CA->USD/CAD); sign(P(A)) = +1 (long the A-currency vs USD) if delta > 0 and A is the pair's BASE currency, -1 if delta > 0 and A is the pair's QUOTE currency (e.g. a BoJ hike strengthens JPY => USD/JPY falls => -1), sign flipped for delta < 0. For A = US, the event drives ALL 7 pairs with the long-USD map on a hike: EUR/USD -1, GBP/USD -1, AUD/USD -1, NZD/USD -1, USD/JPY +1, USD/CHF +1, USD/CAD +1 (flipped on a cut). Decision instant T = the first completed daily 16:00 America/New_York flat bar whose completion instant satisfies T >= a (a row is NEVER eligible on its own effective instant alone; rows without an availability stamp fail closed and are never read). Entry at the open of the next session's 16:00-NY bar after T; hold 10 completed NY-days (anchor); no refresh while the pair's position is open (deterministic tie-break: when two eligible events hit the same pair at the same decision instant, the earlier availability instant wins, the other is ignored). Who is slow: benchmarked allocators and hedging programs on rebalance cycles; when it must fail: if policy changes are fully anticipated and instantly priced, conditional drift is zero - the falsification is live.
falsifiable_prediction: (i) The conditional 10-NY-day forward return in the change-sign direction after availability-gated policy-change events is positive after base cost on the financing-adjusted book, with the price-only book not inverting the anchor expectancy sign; (ii) the asymmetry neighbour (cut holding 3 NY-days vs hike 10) moves WITH the anchor (same verdict sign) - if the drift is real and asymmetric, shortening cut holds does not destroy it; (iii) incremental alpha versus the stale-event benchmark (identical law, every availability instant shifted +180 calendar days) is strictly > 0 - fresh policy information, not the event-timing skeleton alone, must carry the value; (iv) the sham-area causal control (identical clocks, holding law and costs, each area's events driving a DIFFERENT area's pair under a frozen derangement) must NOT reproduce the edge under its preregistered rule; (v) all inherited Stage-A gates pass with tier-2.0 stress as a primary gate.

novelty_statement: Comparison against every row of forbidden_family_inventory.json - different information source AND different causal control for each: (1) V1 family1 session-open (London-open) momentum continuation: the information source here is an EVIDENCED POLICY-EVENT LEDGER (availability-gated rate-change rows), not any session price; there is no session observable, no open-direction continuation rule, no intraday clock; the causal control is a sham-area derangement placebo, absent from all V1/V2 rows. (2) V1 family2 late-NY standardized-extension fade: no price-extension observable and no fade construction anywhere; positions are held 10 NY-days from event availability with a fixed horizon - structurally unrelated, and deliberately not a sign inversion of that row (different observable, information source, clock and holding law). (3) V2 family1 Tokyo-range compression -> London-morning expansion: no session range or compression/expansion transition exists in any arm. (4) V2 family2 London-AM range break with retest-hold: no range break and no retest-hold confirmation exists in any arm. (5) V3 family1 (FXFV3-A5-P1, policy-divergence-gated daily trend): family1 conditioned a PRICE-TREND book on the policy-differential drift (a path/level structure); this family has NO price-trend term anywhere - direction is the event's delta sign read at its availability instant with a fixed holding horizon. Different information (point-event delta vs differential path), different trading law (event-drift vs gated trend), different control (sham-area derangement vs whatever family1 carried). (6) V3 family2 (FXFV3-A6-P1, realized-vol regime-gated policy-rate-differential carry, DATA_AUTHORITY_INVALIDATED): the differential LEVEL (r_base - r_quote) never appears as a signal anywhere in this family - only the event's DELTA sign does; there is no realized-vol state gate, no carry holding law, no financing-dependent direction. This is NOT the Section 1.1 carry front door, invokes none of its conditions, and does not re-grade the invalidated family in any form (no threshold/window/control/stress descendant of it appears here). Blanket clauses: no sign inversion of any rejected family; no cost assumptions below the frozen 1.5 bps x {1.0,1.5,2.0} authority; no pair cherry-picking (the area->pair direction map is fixed ex ante from the authorized universe structure, including the US-drives-all-7 rule); no result-aware reuse of earlier packets. Lane note: A4 owns the policy-rate/carry region; this family uses policy rates in an EVENT-RESPONSE role (delta sign at availability time), never as a differential level or carry direction - the controller's axis-3 brief lists central-bank forward-guidance asymmetry explicitly as open-axis territory, and this packet is the ledger-observable operationalization of that example (guidance text is not in the authorized data; the change's sign, size and availability time are).

pit_observable.conditioning_series: BIS WS_CBPOL policy-rate vintages for the 8 areas backing the 7 pairs, with per-row availability evidence from the pinned v2 announcement ledger (sha256 ae5e1f2e64b8aa7c08472755bd73857543aa89b72ea81b70ad5c5d81e7cd6bd4; citable per research/control/forex_free_v4_run/p2_data_authority_v4.json: policy_rates_bis_wscbpol status EVIDENCED_CITABLE, evidence 'pinned v2 announcement ledger ae5e1f2e, 220 rows; 108/151 rate changes evidenced incl. all 8 areas' baselines; AU INSTANT, NZ/CH DAY, US/GB/JP carried from V3R'). Scored price inputs (fills, PnL) are the authorized H1 snapshot's daily 16:00-NY closes only, frozen span 2020-01-30..2026-09-02 (price_series_byte_replay 152/152 identical). CPI/ECB-ICP series are NOT citable and are not used.
pit_observable.evidence_class: PER-EVENT AVAILABILITY EVIDENCE (the pinned ledger): a row is eligible at decision instant T iff operative_available_time_utc <= T; EVIDENCED rows use their captured stamps (US INSTANT page-release-line, GB DAY, JP DAY, AU INSTANT, NZ/CH DAY); rows without evidence carry the conservative LATER bound already embedded in the ledger and are eligible only at that later bound; rows lacking any availability stamp fail closed (MISSING_AVAILABLE_TIME_EVIDENCE) and are never read. Availability strictly later than effectiveness: no row is eligible on its own effective date alone.
pit_observable.decision_clock: DAILY: the decision for an event is taken at the completion instant of the first daily 16:00 America/New_York flat bar with completion >= the event's availability instant (bar stamps 20:00Z EDT / 21:00Z EST via zoneinfo, DST-aware). Daily-or-slower rule satisfied; no intraday decision anywhere; measured median lag from effective to first-readable is ~1.8 days (lane-counted over the ledger's rate-change rows, max ~1.9), so decisions typically land 2 NY-sessions after effectiveness.

universe.subset_justification: All 7 pairs trade (no subset): the area->pair map is complete and structural - each non-USD area's events drive its own pair, and US events drive all 7 because the USD is a leg of every authorized pair. Direction conventions per pair side are frozen above. No pair is added or removed ex post for any reason.

warmup: No statistical warmup (the law is event-gated, not state-estimated). Structural constraint: fills require the price snapshot, so events whose first decision instant falls before 2020-02-11 (snapshot start + one session + lag) are NO_EVAL fail-closed, never backfilled - this removes the 2019 events (lane-estimated 40-60 pair-events, mostly 2019 US cuts x 7 pairs and AU/NZ 2019 cuts). All 2020-2026 events, including the March 2020 emergency-cut cluster, are in evidence.
holding_period: Anchor: exactly 10 completed NY-days for every event (hike or cut). Neighbour (asymmetry arm): 10 completed NY-days for hikes, 3 for cuts. No targets, no stops, no refresh while open; no position crosses a fold boundary.
entry_rules: At the decision instant T of an eligible event: if the mapped pair is flat, enter sign(P) direction at the open of the next session's 16:00-NY bar (one-event lag). If the mapped pair already holds a position, the event is ignored for that pair (no refresh, no extension, no reversal). Deterministic tie-break: two eligible events mapping to the same pair at the same decision instant resolve to the earlier availability instant; the later is ignored. Governor: max 1 position per pair, max 1 entry per pair per NY-day; blocked signals are NO_TRADE, never deferred.
exit_rules: Exit at the open of the 16:00-NY bar after the H-th completed NY-day following entry (H = 10 anchor; 10/3 hike/cut neighbour). Missing entry/exit bar => signal voided or earliest-scheduled exit, never fill-forward. Force-flat: any open position exits at the open of the 16:00-NY bar of the last decision day before a fold boundary.
fill_convention: Next-session fill at the open of the first 16:00-NY bar of the next NY trading session strictly after the decision instant - at least one full session after the decision (one-event lag) and at most 4 calendar days later over holiday weekends, satisfying the 4-day next-session validator constraint; a would-be fill gap exceeding 4 days fails closed to NO_TRADE. Never same-bar fills, never fill-forward. This arm is fillable by construction: every ledger row carries an availability stamp (evidenced or conservative LATER), so the decision->fill chain never refuses for missing evidence (the V3R lesson - a control that cannot execute has null evidentiary value - is respected for ALL arms).

anchor.spec: Exactly the frozen mechanism law: availability-gated RATE_CHANGE events; frozen area->pair direction map; H = 10 NY-days for all events; next-session fills; force-flat folds; dual book per frozen kernel.

single_frozen_parameter_set.event_rows: RATE_CHANGE rows with delta != 0 of the pinned v2 ledger, all 8 areas
single_frozen_parameter_set.direction_map: A!=US -> unique pair of A; A==US -> all 7 pairs long-USD on hike; base/quote sign convention as frozen in mechanism
single_frozen_parameter_set.entry_lag: one session (next 16:00-NY bar after the first decision T >= a)

neighbour.one_presumption_away: Replaces only the SYMMETRIC-PERSISTENCE presumption (one holding horizon for all events) with the ASYMMETRIC-PERSISTENCE presumption (drift after hikes persists 10 NY-days; drift after cuts is largely priced within 3). If the drift mechanism is real, the neighbour moves TOGETHER with the anchor (same verdict sign, similar fold pattern); divergence means the drift estimate is knife-edge between hike- and cut-driven books and the family is not promotable.
neighbour.spec: Byte-identical to anchor EXCEPT: H_hike = 10 NY-days, H_cut = 3 NY-days (hike/cut classified by the row's delta sign, availability-gated identically). Same events, map, clocks, fills, costs, folds, dual book.

control.role: Placebo-style causal control: destroys exactly the operative ingredient - the AREA-SPECIFIC policy-surprise-to-ITS-OWN-currency link - while holding the event set, clocks, holding law, costs, governor and dual book identical. Each area's events are re-mapped to a DIFFERENT area's pair under a frozen derangement (rotation +3 along the frozen area order), with the direction re-expressed per the sham pair's base/quote convention.

sham_derangement_frozen.rule: sham(X) = area_order[(index(X)+3) mod 8]; event in area X drives P(sham(X)) with sign from X's delta interpreted as a move in sham(X)'s currency (+sign(delta_X) if sham(X) is the sham pair's base, -sign(delta_X) if quote; if sham(X)==US, the long-USD map on all 7 pairs applies)
sham_derangement_frozen.disclosed_leakage: The sham pair always differs from the pair the area's events drive in the anchor, but sham mappings share USD legs and rate cycles cluster globally (2022-2023 synchronized hikes), so the sham book is correlated with the anchor's directional tilts; the control is not independent of the global rate environment - it destroys the area-specific surprise link, which is the ingredient under test. Also disclosed: sham pair-event counts differ from the anchor's (e.g. JP's 5 events drive NZD/USD instead of NZ's 50), so some sham legs are thinner; the book still executes fully under evidenced semantics.

control.spec: Identical to anchor except the mapping above. All else (clocks, H=10, fills, dual book, costs, folds, caps) byte-identical.
control.runs_to_completion: Yes: every sham decision reads a real, availability-gated ledger row and a real snapshot price; the book executes under evidenced semantics with the anchor's fail-closed rules.
control.preregistered_non_reproduction_rule: The control REPRODUCES (and the family FAILS its control gate regardless of the anchor's sign) if control financing-adjusted expectancy > 0 AND control PF >= 1.10, OR control expectancy >= 0.5 x anchor expectancy. Positive raw control PnL never overrides a firing control.

incremental_test.benchmark_definition: Per the frozen benchmark_treatment convention (macro conditioning removed, everything else identical): the anchor law with every event's availability instant shifted +180 calendar days LATER (stale events). The schedule shape, event/clock structure, holding, fills and costs are unchanged; only the freshness of the policy information is removed.
incremental_test.lag_constant: +180 days is a round constant fixed ex ante (two orders of magnitude above the ~1.8-day measured availability lag; never tuned, never data-chosen).
incremental_test.gate: overall incremental alpha > 0: anchor financing-adjusted expectancy minus benchmark financing-adjusted expectancy, evaluated under the same gates as the anchor. Positive raw anchor PnL never overrides a failed incremental alpha. The benchmark is an auxiliary treatment inside the anchor cell, not a fourth scored arm.

costs.application: F1-FIXED: tier multipliers applied to BOOKED stress PnL through the inherited P1 accounting kernel; base / tier-1.5 / tier-2.0 rows pairwise distinct when trades are non-empty. Tier 2.0 is a PRIMARY Stage-A gate.
costs.delay_stress: Frozen one-session delay (entry and exit each shifted one additional 16:00-NY bar) carried as a SEPARATE stress component, never blended into the cost tiers.
costs.break_even_reporting: break_even_bps_per_fill = mean gross per-trade return (bps of the 10000 USD unit, both books) / 2, reported full-sample and per fold. A cell whose break-even bps sits below the tier bps cannot pass Stage-A for cost reasons rather than absence of gross edge; diagnostic, never a fee rescue.

turnover_and_sample_floor.fold_scheme: 3 chronological folds (F1 2020-03-01..2022-05-01, F2 2022-05-01..2024-07-01, F3 2024-07-01..2026-09-02; UTC dates; pre-snapshot events excluded as NO_EVAL). Purge 14 calendar days either side of internal boundaries; trades whose entry OR exit instant falls inside a purge window are excluded from fold statistics and counted in purge_excluded. Stage-A requires >= 2/3 populated folds positive; a fold is populated iff >= 30 trades.
turnover_and_sample_floor.decisions_estimate: Lane-counted ledger rows: 212 RATE_CHANGE across AU 50, NZ 50, CA 22, CH 22, GB 22, US 22, EMU 19, JP 5, effective 2019-05..2026-07. Pair-event decisions: non-US areas 190 + US 22x7 = 344 pair-events gross; pre-snapshot NO_EVAL removes an est. 40-60 (2019 events, mostly US x 7 and AU/NZ); est. 290-315 decisions remain; >= 40 per arm satisfied with wide margin.
turnover_and_sample_floor.trades_estimate: After the flat-only/no-refresh dedup of the March-2020-type clusters (same-pair repeats within the 10-day hold are dropped), est. 180-260 scored trades across 7 pairs full-sample. Preregistered band 25-45 pair-events per year.

sample_floors.populated_rule: fold populated iff >= 30 trades; a cell below floors is INDETERMINATE, not negative evidence. DISCLOSED: the trades estimate margin over the 140 floor is thin (est. 1.3-1.9x) - a below-floor outcome is a live possibility and is recorded as INDETERMINATE, never as evidence either way.

turnover_and_sample_floor.cost_thesis: The 10-day drift window is the cost thesis: conditional drift must exceed 3 bps RT at base tier (6 bps at tier 2.0). Break-even bps per cell will attribute any reject to cost vs gross absence.

drop_one_design.procedure: Recompute the full anchor schedule (and neighbour/control/bench identically) 8 times: 7 pair-drops (each excluding exactly one pair) + the inherited best-fold drop.
drop_one_design.gate: Anchor financing-adjusted expectancy > 0 AND PF >= 1.00 in at least 6 of 8 scenarios (inherited M1-DEV constants verbatim).
drop_one_design.non_vacuity_and_limitation: Each pair-drop changes the schedule; asserted at implementation as a difference test (>= 1 trade differs). DISCLOSED LIMITATION: dropping USD/JPY removes only ~5 trades (JP has 5 rate changes in the window) - that scenario is near-vacuous by data scarcity, not by design; the gate can only detect pair-concentration through the other 6 pairs. Fold spread is likewise lumpy: JP trades land late-window (F3).
drop_one_design.interpretation: Failure means the edge is a single-pair/area artifact (e.g. one currency's hiking episode), not a policy-event drift mechanism.

governor.enforcement: Deterministic and PIT-safe; blocked signals are NO_TRADE, never deferred; tie-break = earlier availability instant.

dual_book_and_financing.mandate: Every scored cell books BOTH price_only_pnl_usd and financing_adjusted_pnl_usd as separate immutable digest-covered columns, all arms (inherited kernel).
dual_book_and_financing.financing_formula_frozen_verbatim: financing_adjusted_pnl = price_only_pnl + sign * notional_usd * (r_base - r_quote) * holding_days/365, accrued per calendar day at the day-start as-of policy-rate differential from the evidenced vintages (rows eligible only when available_time_utc <= the accrual instant; never eligible on their own effective date).
dual_book_and_financing.disclosed_approximation: Policy rates are unsecured official rates, NOT swap/OIS-implied rollover; disclosed ex ante per inherited convention (HISTORICAL_ROLLOVER_FINANCING UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED).
dual_book_and_financing.financing_gate: The financing term must not manufacture the edge: the price-only book must not invert the anchor expectancy sign (Stage-A gate). Particular care in this family: during a US hiking cycle the drift book is USD-long AND the differential accrual is USD-positive - a price-only sign inversion would prove the book earns financing, not drift.

failure_interpretation: Negative anchor expectancy after base cost: availability-gated policy-change events carry no after-cost drift edge at the frozen cost authority on this snapshot - a complete, publishable reject with break-even bps attributing cost vs gross absence; no sign inversion, no horizon/threshold rescue, no pair subset, no lower cost, no re-clocking. Anchor positive but the sham-area control fires under its preregistered rule: the area-specific surprise link is not operative (global rate-wave beta or the event skeleton alone explains it) and the family fails its control gate regardless of anchor sign. Anchor positive but incremental alpha <= 0 vs the +180d stale-event benchmark: fresh policy information adds nothing beyond the event timing; the underreaction claim is falsified and the family is not promotable. Anchor positive on financing-adjusted but price-only inverts the expectancy sign: the edge is manufactured by the financing approximation; fails the dual-book gate. Neighbour diverges from anchor: hike/cut drift decomposition is knife-edge fragile; not promotable. Drop-one or concentration failure: single-pair/area artifact; reject. Trades below the 140 floor: INDETERMINATE (recorded as such, never spun as negative or positive evidence). Realized turnover outside the preregistered band: INELIGIBLE per the frequency contract. Any gate failure is terminal for the family as specified - the map, horizons, staleness and clocks are never re-tuned post-observation.

margin_to_fail_expectations.note: Ex ante, per Stage-A gate, written before any V4 outcome exists. Numbers are expectations/priors, never measurements.
margin_to_fail_expectations.expectancy_gt_0: If residual drift exists, expected fin-adj expectancy +2 to +20 per 10k-unit trade (event mixes anticipated and surprise components, so the prior is wide); genuine reject is a live outcome. Knife-edge risk HIGH.
margin_to_fail_expectations.pf_ge_110: Expected 1.00-1.20 if real. Knife-edge risk HIGH.
margin_to_fail_expectations.folds_positive_ge_2_of_3: F1 contains the March-2020 emergency cluster (large same-direction books) and F2/F3 contain the 2022-2023 synchronized hikes; lumpy event arrival makes fold signs genuinely uncertain. Expected 2/3 positive if real; fold-population margin est. 1.5-2.7x the 30-trade floor in F1 - MODERATE.
margin_to_fail_expectations.mdd_within_frozen_ceiling: Clustered multi-pair same-direction entries (March 2020; 2022 hiking wave) drive MDD; expected 900-2200 USD vs the frozen 2500 ceiling -> margin 300-1600. MODERATE.
margin_to_fail_expectations.stress_tier_2_0_primary: Gross per-trade must clear 6 bps RT at tier 2.0; expected gross 15-70 bps IF drift exists; expected tier-2.0 PF 0.95-1.15. Knife-edge risk HIGH - historically the killing gate.
margin_to_fail_expectations.fold_positive_share_and_concentration: Restated inherited gates apply verbatim (max_positive_fold_share 0.5, max_pair_positive_share 0.4; the kernel's definition governs where prose differs). Expected max-pair share 20-45% given event clustering on US events (7-pair legs) - knife-edge MODERATE-HIGH.
margin_to_fail_expectations.usd_drift_gate: DISCLOSED HIGH RISK - the most likely single-gate failure: US events are 22 of 212 rows but ~154 of ~344 pair-events (~45%), producing USD-wide positions during US tightening/easing cycles; expected |corr(daily PnL, USD-wide move)| 0.2-0.5 vs the 0.3 ceiling. If it fails, the family fails completely - disclosed ex ante, never tuned around. Mitigation attempted and rejected ex ante: excluding US-area events was considered and rejected because it drops the trade count below the 140 floor (INDETERMINATE by construction) - a worse, self-inflicted failure mode.
margin_to_fail_expectations.incremental_alpha_gt_0: Fresh-vs-stale separation is clean (rare, date-specific events; +180d staleness cannot coincide with the drift window); expected positive margin IF the mechanism is real. Residual risk LOW-MODERATE.
margin_to_fail_expectations.control_non_reproduction: Disclosed leakage through global rate waves could make the sham book fire (synchronized cycles share direction); expected control expectancy <= 0.5 x anchor IF the area-specific claim is right; firing is a genuine MODERATE risk.
margin_to_fail_expectations.sample_floor: Decisions margin ~7x floor (comfortable); trades margin est. 1.3-1.9x the 140 floor - THIN; a below-floor cell is INDETERMINATE by frozen rule. This is the family's second most likely failure mode after the USD-drift gate.

The packet declares in advance: an INDETERMINATE (below-floor) or USD-drift-failed outcome is a complete, honest terminal for this family.

no_parameter_grid_note: Exactly one frozen value per constant per arm (the area->pair map, H = 10, H_cut = 3 in the neighbour only, +3 derangement rotation, +180-day benchmark shift). No grids, menus or tuning anywhere; the neighbour is a distinct single frozen spec, not a second point on the anchor's knob; the benchmark staleness is fixed, never fit.
lane_diversity_note: A4 owns the policy-rate/carry region (differential LEVEL direction, including the Section 1.1 front door); this family never reads a differential level as a signal - the only policy input is the evidenced event's delta sign at its availability instant (event-response dynamics), the controller-sanctioned open-axis operationalization of 'central-bank forward-guidance asymmetry'. A5 owns inflation/real-rate structure; no price-level or inflation series appears here. The wave therefore spans three genuinely different conditioning sources.
